title: TOEIC 每日練習 Day 17（2026-11-14）
summary: 最新成績仍是 Day 13 的 17/25（Day 14–16 還沒交卷）。今天繼續練弱點：if 子句和 will／would 配對（3 題，含 If I were you）、keep／make／find + 受詞 + 形容詞（3 題，含副詞修飾形容詞對照）、whose／who 對照、Although 與 Despite、be in charge of、Part 7 的 instead of 舊地點陷阱和 NOT 題、Part 2 的同字異義陷阱（close、check、room）。聽力今天是 Part 3 兩人對話。做完按「交卷」就會自動回傳成績。

sections.heading: Part 5 文法與字彙（建議 11 分鐘）
sections.tip: 假設語氣先看主要子句：will 配 if 現在式；would 配 if 過去式（be 用 were）。make／keep／find + 受詞 + 空格：描述受詞用形容詞；但空格後面若還有形容詞，空格就是副詞。Although 接句子，Despite 接名詞。

qs.stem: If the shipment ------- on time, we will open the new store on Monday.
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. 主要子句 will open ＝ 真實可能發生。2. if 子句用現在式，主詞 the shipment 單數，用 arrives。3. 選 B。A、D 是過去式／過去完成式，只能配 would。

qs.stem: If I ------- you, I would ask the manager for a day off.
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. 主要子句 would ask ＝ 與現在事實相反（我不是你）。2. if 子句的 be 動詞一律用 were。3. 選 C。這是 TOEIC 最常見的假設句型 If I were you。

qs.stem: If the company had a bigger budget, it ------- more advertising online.
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. if 子句 had（過去式）＝ 與現在事實相反。2. 主要子句用 would + 原形。3. 選 B。A will buy 是 Day 13 Q4 的同類陷阱。

qs.stem: Regular cleaning keeps the equipment ------- for many years.
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. keeps + 受詞（the equipment）+ 空格，描述受詞狀態用形容詞。2. 選 useful。A -ly 副詞是陷阱。

qs.stem: The new software makes the report ------- to read.
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. make + 受詞（the report）+ 形容詞。2. easy to read ＝ 容易閱讀。3. 選 A。B easily 是 Day 13 Q6 的同類陷阱。

qs.stem: Employees found the new schedule ------- difficult to follow.
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. find + 受詞 + 形容詞：difficult 已經是形容詞。2. 空格修飾形容詞 difficult，用副詞 extremely（非常）。3. 選 B。對照上一題：空格後還有形容詞，空格才是副詞。

qs.stem: We need a supplier ------- prices are lower than our current one.
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. 空格後先出現名詞 prices，再接動詞 are。2. 「那家供應商『的』價格」。3. 選 whose。

qs.stem: The customer ------- called this morning wants a refund.
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. 空格後直接接動詞 called，缺主詞。2. 先行詞 customer 是人，用 who。3. 選 B。和上一題對照：後面是名詞選 whose，是動詞選 who。

qs.stem: ------- the bus was late, Mr. Kim arrived at the meeting on time.
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. 空格後 the bus was late 是完整句子（有動詞 was）。2. 語意是讓步，要用連接詞 Although。3. 選 B。A、C 後面只能接名詞片語；D 語意不合。

qs.stem: All applicants should ------- a copy of their résumé to the interview.
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. 助動詞 should 後面接原形動詞。2. 選 bring。

qs.stem: Mr. Nakamura is in charge ------- the company's social media accounts.
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. be in charge of ＝ 負責，固定搭配。2. 選 C。易混淆：be responsible for 用 for，in charge 用 of。

qs.stem: The hotel offers a free shuttle bus ------- guests to the airport.
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. 句子已有主要動詞 offers。2. 空格表示目的「用來載客人去機場」，用不定詞 to take。3. 選 B。

sections.heading: Part 7 短篇閱讀（建議 9 分鐘）
sections.tip: 先讀題目、圈關鍵字（mainly、Where、must、NOT），再回原文找那一句。看到 A instead of B，A 是新的、B 是舊的。NOT 題四個選項都要回原文打勾。
passage: Riverside Community Center — Gym Floor Repair
The gym on the first floor will be closed from Monday, November 23, to Friday, November 27, while the wooden floor is repaired. The fitness room on the second floor will stay open as usual.

During this time, basketball and badminton classes will be held at Lakeview High School instead of the community center. Members can use the school gym at no extra cost by showing their membership card.
The center apologizes for any inconvenience. For more information, please visit the front desk or call 555-0182.

qs.stem: What is the notice mainly about?
opts: The temporary closing of a gym
The opening of a high school
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. 主旨題看標題與第一句：Gym Floor Repair，gym will be closed。2. 選 B。

qs.stem: Where will basketball classes be held next week?
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. 找 basketball：will be held at Lakeview High School instead of the community center。2. instead of 後面是「原本的」地點。3. 選 C。B 是舊地點陷阱。

qs.stem: What must members do to use the school gym?
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. 找 use the school gym：at no extra cost by showing their membership card。2. 選 B。A 是陷阱：at no extra cost ＝ 不用額外付費。

qs.stem: What is NOT mentioned in the notice?
opts: Why the gym will be closed
How long the repair will take
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：NOT 題逐一打勾。A：floor is repaired，有。B：fitness room on the second floor，有。C：11/23 到 11/27，有。D：沒說誰來修，選 D。

sections.heading: Part 2 聽力應答（建議 6 分鐘）
sections.tip: 先聽清楚第一個字（Haven't／Why don't／Who／or／When／Can you）。Wh 問句不用 Yes 回答；選項裡重複題目的字或發音相近的字（close／clothes、to／two）通常是陷阱。

qs.stem: Haven't you finished the sales report yet?
opts: No, I need one more hour.
It was a good report card.
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. 把 not 拿掉：Have you finished the report?。2. B「還沒，再一小時」直接回答。3. A 用 sales／sale 陷阱；C 重複 report。

qs.stem: Why don't you ask Ms. Lee for help?
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. Why don't you…? ＝ 建議「你何不……」。2. B「好主意」接受建議。3. A 是 Because 開頭陷阱（Day 13 Q18 錯過這招）；C 重複 help。

qs.stem: Who should I give these documents to?
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. Who 問人。2. A「交給櫃台人員」。3. B 是 Yes 陷阱（Wh 問句不用 Yes／No 回答）；C 回答 When，且 to／two 同音陷阱。

qs.stem: Should we take a taxi or walk to the station?
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. 選擇疑問句先刪 Yes 開頭的 B。2. A「只要五分鐘」＝ 間接表示用走的。3. C 重複 taxi。TOEIC 常用間接回答當正解。

qs.stem: When does the store close tonight?
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. When 問時間。2. B「九點」。3. A 用 close（靠近）同字異義陷阱；C 用 clothes／close 發音相近陷阱。

qs.stem: Can you check the room for the meeting?
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. Can you…? 是請求。2. A「好，我現在就去」。3. B 用 check（支票）同字異義陷阱；C 用 room（空間）同字異義陷阱。

sections.heading: Part 3 兩人對話（建議 4 分鐘）
sections.tip: 播放前先讀三題，圈出 problem、reject、this afternoon。對話裡有 8、10、12 三個數字，注意各指什麼。最後一題聽 I'll… 那一句。
script: Man: Hi Sarah, I just got an e-mail from the hotel. The conference room we booked for Thursday's client meeting has a problem with the air conditioning.
Woman: Oh no. Can they give us another room? We have twelve people coming at ten o'clock.
Man: They offered a smaller room on the fifth floor, but it only holds eight people. I think we should use our own meeting room here at the office instead.
Woman: Good idea. I'll send a message to the clients this afternoon with the new address.

qs.stem: What problem does the man mention?
opts: The air conditioning in a room is not working
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. 問題題聽 problem 那句：has a problem with the air conditioning。2. 選 B。

qs.stem: Why does the man reject the hotel's offer?
opts: The room is too far away
The room is not available on Thursday
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. 聽 but 之後：it only holds eight people，但有 twelve people 要來。2. 選 B。數字 8、10、12 各指不同東西，注意分辨。

qs.stem: What will the woman do this afternoon?
opts: Send a message to the clients
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. 下一步動作題，鎖定 I'll…：I'll send a message to the clients this afternoon。2. 選 C。A、B 是對話中提到但不是她要做的事。
